subject: business-studies

items.q: Are profit and cash flow the same?
items.correct: No — a profitable business can still run out of cash.
items.misconception: Yes, profit and cash are identical.
items.random_wrong: Revenue is the same as profit.
items.why: Profit = revenue − costs; cash flow is the timing of money in and out.

items.correct: Total income from sales before costs are taken off.
items.why: Revenue = price × quantity sold; profit is what remains after costs.

specSource: Cambridge IGCSE Business Studies (0450) syllabus; Operations Management
